gh pr create --base main --head codex/evaluation-foundry-heritage --title "Build Coventry and Warwickshire heritage Evaluation Foundry" --body '## Summary

- add a production-scale Evaluation Foundry exemplar covering the supported NHLE and Heritage at Risk sources intersecting Coventry and Warwickshire
- add a separate three-record assurance fixture and an isolated, default-off synthetic capability supplement
- extend OKF Markdown front matter to backward-compatible YAML-LD and use it for graph, provenance, rich links, deep links, and heritage detail in OKF Explorer
- add alternative-name and explainable edit-distance-one search, source/rich-link contracts, deterministic receipts, beginner guidance, and a detailed evaluation report

## Scope

The faithful corpus contains 7,640 records, 22,200 resources, and 9,566 relationship assertions. Its source snapshot is frozen and provenance-bound. The Site build contains 14,007 files and remains 12,575,372 bytes below the enforced 1 GB publication limit.

## Publication protocol

This is the deliberately unadvertised candidate phase. Public bundle calls-to-action, registry discovery, and copy-ready URLs remain withheld until the exact merged Pages deployment passes real-browser identity, link, Markdown, deep-link, and journey checks. A follow-up promotion PR will add a separate public deployment receipt and expose only the verified URLs.

## Validation

- 176 Python tests on Python 3.14 and 3.12
- 276 Vitest tests plus 24 Node tests
- 153 Explorer browser tests and 63 Foundry Site browser tests across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit
- 100/100 evaluation questions, average score 92.7
- faithful, tiny, and synthetic consumer journeys all pass
- deterministic corpus, app, receipt, link, semantic, bundle, viewer, registry, documentation-lockstep, and Pages-size gates all pass'
